name: Re:Battlegrounds (Uncopylocked)
desc:
Discontinued, sorry. Open-source now tho.

battlegrounds about ReZero cause apparently there is no games about it. Ok but fr this is literally JJS but with Re:Zero. I made it for fun, and I don't really expect to get it popular or to monetize it that much. All in all, just thanks for playing my dumb game.

CONTROLS:
M1 - Attack
M1 + Jump - Aerial Attack
F - Block
Q - Dash / Ragdoll cancel
W + W - Run
G - Awakening
M - Moveset Menu
B  - Emotes

destruction & combat based off JJS

version: 0.4.0
full release on v1.0.0; currently in beta (expect lots of bugs)
